'''Please read this Page until the end before asking or suggesting anything in the [https://discord.com/invite/WPuhKDU Discord Server] or Curseforge Page. Thanks.'''

Please make sure you're playing on the [[Current Version|most recent version]]!  Each version has more and newer content, along with a lot of bug fixes.  If you're encountering a bug on an older version, it was probably fixed in a newer one.

== ''Most Common Questions'' ==

=== '''Why aren't any Parasites appearing?''' ===
Parasite spawning is dictated by [[Evolution Phases]].  In the starting Phase, which is Phase 0 in the Overworld, only [[Buglin|Buglins]] will spawn.  As Parasites obtain more [[Evolution Phases#Obtaining Points|Points]] (which they get by killing and assimilating Mobs, infesting blocks through [[Beckon|Beckons]], and [[Evolution System|merging]]) [[Evolution Phases]] will go up, and the spawning will change and increase with them. Phases do not rely on days or time, only Points. Sometimes this may take a while, depending on World Generation.  You can check the amount of points with [[commands]].  

Please read the [[Evolution Phases]] Page for more information on how they work. If you have updated from an old Version, delete the config file and restart your game, as they may not be able to spawn and other bugs could occur.

== ''Mod Related Questions'' ==

=== '''Is this Mod available only on Forge?''' === 
Yes, specifically for Forge 1.12.2. 

===  '''When will there be a Port?''' === 
Dhanantry specified that he wants to finish the Mod in 1.12.2. This means that there are no plans regarding Ports. <u>No Ports are allowed without Developer permission, including Bedrock Ports</u>. Attempts to make unauthorized Ports will be halted. If you discover an unauthorized Bedrock Port/Addon, please report it [https://discord.gg/3W5ZSQ8yVj here].  

===  '''When will the next update come out?''' ===
Be patient. Updates take a lot of time and effort, more than you think. This Mod has NOT been abandoned. There is no ETA, it'll be done when it is done.

== ''Game Related Questions'' ==

=== '''How do i change SRP difficulty on server or already created world?''' ===
to do that, go to dat-editor.com, get "srparasites_global_data.dat" in your world\data folder to that website, expand data and change srpchoice value to this values: 0 (easy), 1 (normal), 2 (hard), and 3 (impossible). Download it as .dat and replace it in data folder then restart your server/world. you can do the same with meteor by changing srpmeteor to 1 (active) or 0 (not active) in "srparasites_data.dat".

=== '''Why aren't Parasites gaining points?''' ===
This is likely caused by the Point Gain Delay. For 20 minutes after reaching a new [[Evolution Phases|Phase]], Parasites will not be able to gain Points. This can be circumvented with the command ''/time add 24000'', or setting the Phase # Delay option in the config to 1. World Generation may massively speed up or hinder Point gaining. The presence of other Mods can massively effect Point gaining as well.

=== '''How can I reduce Points?''' ===
You can use [[Lures|Carcasses]] or kill parasites to reduce Points. See the [[Lures]] and [[Evolution Phases]] page on how to create a Carcass in order to reduce points. 

=== '''Why aren't Parasites/Rupters attacking Mobs?''' ===
Parasites leave Passive Mobs to [[Rupter|Rupters]] and [[Mangler|Manglers]], because they're the only Parasites with a 100% chance to assimilate Mobs. Rupters will not immediately attack Mobs in [[Evolution Phases|Phases]] 0 and 1, but give Mobs the [[Call Of The Hive]] Effect, which will slowly assimilate them. 

=== '''What blocks can Parasites break?''' ===
You can learn more about which blocks parasites can break, and see suggestions on what blocks to build with, on the [[Hardness]] page.  

=== '''Where can I find the Parasite Biome?''' ===
The [[Parasite Biome|Biome]] is generated by [[Parasite Biome#Node|Nodes]], which are created by [[Parasite Biome#Stage IV Beckon|Stage IV Beckons]], starting from [[Ubiquitous Development#Level 4|Ubiquitous Development Level 4]]. 

=== '''How do I remove the Green/Brown Blocks or Parasite Biome?''' ===
*The green/brown blocks, or Infested Blocks, are produced by [[Stage I Beckon|Stage I]], [[Stage II Beckon|II]] and [[Stage III Beckon|III Beckons]]. Kill them all and cover the whole Infested Zone in lava or destroy them to prevent more Beckons from spawning from them. ONLY after killing a Stage I Beckon will all the Infested Blocks be reverted into Dirt by [[Residue]];
*Blocks that have a Red and Black color palette are created by the [[Parasite Biome]]. Kill the Stage IV Beckon at the center of the Biome and destroy the Node to prevent spreading of the Parasite Biome. If you want to clean up the Biome mess use [[Parasite Biome#Biome Purifiers|Purifiers]], which will change the ID of 3x3 chunks of the Biome into a Plains Biome and stopping Parasite spawning. The Blocks won't disappear.

=== '''Why isn’t this Parasite dying/taking damage?''' ===
This is likely the [[Adaptation System]]. Some Parasites can learn Damage Sources as they get hit, eventually becoming nearly invulnerable to them.  

*They adapt per hit, so avoid Weapons that do damage in many hits, and instead focus on Weapons that do massive damage in single hits.  
*If a parasite flashes green, it is currently adapting to a damage source. Once the parasite flashes purple, it has adapted to the damage source to the best of its abilities.
*Fire slows and delays Adaptation, so it is crucial when fighting these Parasites.  
*You can also cut off tendrils to reset a Parasite's Adaptation, or hit Weak Points to deal increased damage. Tendrils and Weak Points have their own hitboxes, which can be seen by pressing F3+B.

More info regarding Adaptation can be seen on its [[Adaptation System|own Page]]. If you want to nerf Adaptation, you can do so in the config file.

=== '''Why did a number appear in chat?''' ===
Parasites have reached the next [[Evolution Phases|Phase]] from gaining Points, the message in chat is a warning of such. You can check what Phase you are in with a [[Bloody Clock]], or the using the [[Commands|command]] ''/srpevolution getphase'', this will only work when Cheats are enabled.

=== '''Can I cure Assimilated Mobs?''' ===
No. [[Call Of The Hive|COTH]] only affects the player after death, and you can use the [[Camouflage]] Effect on your animals to try to prevent COTH, note it is not 100% effective. COTH cannot pass through blocks, use this to protect your animals. More info regarding the COTH Effect can be seen on its [[Call Of The Hive|own Page]].

=== '''Why are Beckons/Dispatchers/etc dying when I spawn them?''' ===
By default, [[:Category:Nexus Parasites|Nexus]] and [[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrents]] will start dying when they spawn before [[Evolution Phases#Phase 3|Phase 3]].  This is because they cannot naturally occur in Phase 2 or lower, unless the phase is lowered with Lures.  To circumvent this, set the dimension to Phase 3 using [[commands]].  There is an option in the config to disable this as well.

=== '''What are the Mod's Commands?''' ===
See the [[Commands]] Page. '''<u>Commands only work if Cheats are ENABLED.</u>'''

=== '''What are the Parasite's Classifications?''' ===
Parasites are not undead, nor are they arthropods. Use Sharpness and fire Enchantments such as Fire Aspect or Flame.

=== '''Can [[Weapons|Sentient Weapons]]/[[Sentient Armor|Armor]] be crafted? ''' ===
No, Sentient Weapons/Armor cannot be crafted. In order to obtain Sentient Weapons/Armor you must craft Living Weapons/Armor and use them a specific amount in order to evolve them into their Sentient Forms.

=== '''How can I get the Parasites to spawn more?''' ===
Turn your render distance to 10 or above, as a Vanilla bug causes mobs to spawn less if your render distance is below 10. Quote from the [https://minecraft.fandom.com/wiki/Spawn#Spawn_conditions Minecraft Wiki]: "''If the Player's view distance or the server view distance in Multiplayer is at 9 or below, Mob spawning is severely reduced (or they despawn too quickly), and may result in the Player encountering no Mobs at all. Set the view distance to 10 or higher to ensure Mobs spawn correctly.''" <br>You can also try installing the [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/increasemobs IncreaseMobs] Mod, at your own risk.  You can also increase the Parasite's Mob Cap in the config file, allowing more parasites to exist at once. You may also try increasing parasite cap using configuration of the mod.

=== '''How do I deal with the [[Assimilated Enderman]]?''' ===
Try to use strong(er) '''Armor''' and '''Weapons''', preferably enchanted with '''Fire Aspect''' or '''Flame'''. If you feel underprepared to fight the Assimilated Enderman, towering up 5 blocks can let you attack it while it's unable to reach you. 
''<s>You could lower their spawnweight or teleportation rate in the config file, <u>but we strongly suggest not disabling them entirely</u>.</s>''

''Hint'': they cannot teleport [[Assimilated Mobs]] into spaces they can't walk through (3 blocks tall), but keep in mind some Assimilated Enderman can crawl.

=== '''There is a lot of sound going around when i do something, what are those coming from?''' ===
Its a new feature added in 1.10.0 version of SRP, [[Dislodgment System]]. When you do something you will hear a sound which omens that one of the codes is activated.<!-- This bug will be fixed in 1.9.6-->

== ''Issue Related Questions'' ==

=== Why aren't Parasites spawning in my world? ===
As of 1.10.0 version of SRP parasites spawn in [[Emerging Infestation Vector|Emerging Infestation Vectors]] (EIV).

Solution to this is disabling EIV through the configuration, or second solution, decreasing maximum radius of the vector through the configuration. You can find it in config -> SRparasites -> SRParasitesWorld. Any number below 20 million will work for sure.

Do not change "default default range" because this is a number with which vector's radius will start with, this is not maximum radius vector can have.

=== Why is my phase randomly reset to 0? ===
As of 1.10.0 Emerging Infestation Vectors were added (EIV).

The problem is in overflowing health of vector, it has a feature to add points depending on its health value and maximum vector's health on default is 2 billion (2,000,000,000) which overflows the maximum amount of points added at 1 time and resets the evolution points to 0.

The solution is to go to configuration of the mod, open srparasites -> srparasitesworld. Then find and edit the maximum health of vectors. IMPORTANT: do not forget to delete old vectors using command: "/srpvectors clearworld" because they will still have 2 billon health.

=== '''Why didn't [[Moving Flesh]] generate a Parasite?''' ===
If Moving Flesh [[Evolution System|merges]] and grows bigger indicating it will spawn a Parasite but nothing spawns, you likely have an old config file. Delete your config file and restart your game to fix this issue. Otherwise, their pathfinding may have broken or nearby Moving Flesh was killed before it could merge.

=== '''Why are Parasites attacking each other?''' ===
This is a bug caused by the Epic Siege Mod. If you have it installed and this bug shows up, you'll have to blacklist the Parasites on the Epic Siege Config in order to not make them kill each other.

=== '''Why is the Node not spreading the [[Parasite Biome|Biome]]?''' ===
This is a bug caused by the Just Enough IDs mod.  If you have it installed, the [[Parasite Biome|Biome]] cannot be spread by [[Parasite Biome#Node|Nodes]]. Alternatively you could use the mod Not Enough IDs, but your World may unfortunately corrupt when uninstalling JEIDs.

=== '''I can't install the Mod on Aternos / Please enable 3rd party distribution.''' ===
Due to some API changes CurseForge has done, Mods' Developers can now choose if they want their Mod distributed on 3rd party platforms. Therefore, many Mods, including this one, are no longer available for direct download for those services, including MultiMC, Aternos, and many others. <u>This is not likely to change.</u>  You will have to manually download and install Scape and Run: Parasites to play with it, unless you use the CurseForge launcher. Currently, it is impossible to use Scape and Run: Parasites on an Aternos server. PloudOS, however, allows you to upload Mod's files, so you can use this instead. If PloudOS does not work, keep looking for other free services that allow you to upload Mod's files.  Direct further questions to the Mod's [https://discord.com/invite/WPuhKDU Discord Server].

=== '''My issue isn't listed here!''' ===
Most of the time, unforeseen issues that occur after updating the mod can be fixed by deleting the config and restarting your game, as old configs are known to mess with the mod.  If this does not fix your issue, please join our [https://discord.com/invite/WPuhKDU Discord Server] so we can assist you further.

== ''Extras'' ==

*There is no Official Map for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod. Forge Labs' Map isn't Official. It is suggested to install the [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/biomes-o-plenty Biomes O' Plenty] and [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/roguelike-dungeons Roguelike Dungeons] Mods in order to have everything from FL Map, except the houses and the lab;
*There is no Official Modpack for the Scape and Run: Parasites Mod;
*There is no "Parasite Dimension". You're probably thinking of [https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/angry-pixel-the-betweenlands-mod/screenshots The Betweenlands] Mod;
*Regarding Questions related to RLCraft, Parasites only spawn in the Lost City Dimension, and will instantly die in any other Dimension.  Parasites are also heavily buffed compared to the Mod's default settings. Redirect any further questions to the [https://discord.gg/tW2Q2Mk8dN RLCraft Discord Server].

== ''Other Mods'' ==
<u>Scape and Run: Parasites is not balanced for a vanilla-only experience, so it's recommended to have a few more mods installed.</u><br>
If you're having trouble dealing with parasites, don't just run in punching after you die, employ the use of better equipment.  If something doesn’t work, try something else instead of doing the same thing over and over.  Good luck!
